form.current-chamber: IN THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES

action.action-desc: Mr. Banks (for himself, Mr. Kim, and Mr. Fetterman) introduced the following bill; which was read twice and referred to the Committee on Finance

form.official-title: To amend titles XI, XIX, and XXI of the Social Security Act with respect to screening for childhood-onset fluency disorders, and to require coverage of certain speech therapy services under Medicaid and CHIP.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Kidd’s Stuttering Act.

section.header: Expanding screening and requiring coverage of certain speech therapy services under Medicaid and CHIP

subsection.header: Inclusion of screening for stuttering and speech fluency in core set of child health quality measures
subsection.text: Section 1139A(b)(5) of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1320b–9a(b)(5)) is amended—

paragraph.text: by striking Beginning no later than and inserting the following:
by adding at the end the following new subparagraph:

subparagraph.header: Screening for stuttering and speech fluency

clause.text: Not later than January 1, 2028, the Secretary shall publish changes to the core measures described in subsection (a) to include measures of screening for childhood-onset fluency disorders, including stuttering, for children who have attained the age of 2 (and have not attained the age of 6).
The Secretary shall publish the changes required by clause (i) at the same time and in the same manner as the relevant annual recommended changes required under subparagraph (A).

subsection.header: Required screening for stuttering and speech fluency in Medicaid well-Child visits
subsection.text: Section 1905(r)(1)(B) of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1396d(r)(1)(B)) is amended—

paragraph.text: in clause (iv), by striking and at the end;
in clause (v), by striking the period at the end and inserting , and; and
by adding at the end the following new clause:

clause.text: beginning January 1, 2029, for children who have attained the age of 2 (and have not attained the age of 6), screening for childhood-onset fluency disorders, including stuttering.

subsection.header: Required coverage of certain speech therapy services

paragraph.text: Title XIX of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1396 et seq.) is amended—

clause.text: in paragraph (10)(A), by striking and (30) and inserting (30), and (32);
in paragraph (89), by striking and at the end;
in paragraph (90)(C), by striking the period at the end and inserting ; and; and
by inserting after paragraph (90) the following new paragraph:

paragraph.text: provide that the treatment limitations applicable to specified speech therapy services (as defined in section 1905(ll)) are no more restrictive than the treatment limitations applicable to any speech therapy services for the treatment of expressive language disorder, receptive language disorder, mixed expressive and receptive language disorder, or articulation, for which medical assistance is provided under the State plan (or waiver of such plan).

subclause.text: in paragraph (31), by striking and at the end;
by redesignating paragraph (32) as paragraph (33); and
by inserting after paragraph (31) the following new paragraph:

paragraph.text: beginning on January 1, 2029, specified speech therapy services (as defined in subsection (ll)); and

clause.text: by adding at the end the following new subsection:

subsection.text: For purposes of subsection (a)(32), the term specified speech therapy services—

paragraph.text: means speech therapy services for the treatment of childhood-onset fluency disorders, including stuttering, provided to—

subparagraph.text: individuals who have not attained 21 years of age; and

paragraph.text: includes such services delivered through real-time, audio and video telecommunications technology.

subparagraph.text: in section 1932(b), by adding at the end the following new paragraph:

paragraph.header: Parity in coverage of speech therapy services
paragraph.text: A medicaid managed care organization, prepaid inpatient health plan (as defined by the Secretary), prepaid ambulatory health plan (as defined by the Secretary), and, when appropriate, primary care case management entity (as defined by the Secretary) with a contract with a State that provides for coverage of specified speech therapy services (as such term is defined in section 1905(ll)) shall establish procedures to ensure compliance with the requirements of section 1902(a)(91).

clause.text: in paragraph (1), in the matter preceding subparagraph (A), by striking paragraphs (5) and (6) and inserting the succeeding provisions of this subsection; and
by adding at the end the following new paragraph:

paragraph.header: Coverage of specified speech therapy services
paragraph.text: Notwithstanding the previous provisions of this section, a State may not provide for medical assistance through enrollment of an individual with benchmark coverage or benchmark-equivalent coverage under this section unless the individual has access, through such coverage or otherwise, to specified speech therapy services (as defined in section 1905(ll)) that are provided in accordance with the requirements of section 1902(a)(91).

subparagraph.text: Section 2103(c) of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1397cc(c)) is amended by adding at the end the following new paragraph:

paragraph.header: Required coverage of certain speech therapy services
paragraph.text: Beginning January 1, 2029, the child health assistance provided to a targeted low-income child and, in the case of a State that elects to provide pregnancy-related assistance pursuant to section 2112, the pregnancy-related assistance provided for a targeted low-income pregnant woman (as such terms are defined for purposes of such section) shall include coverage of specified speech therapy services (as such term is defined in section 1905(ll)).

subparagraph.text: Section 2107(e)(1) of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1397gg(e)(1)) is amended—

clause.text: by redesignating subparagraphs (I) through (W) as subparagraphs (J) through (X), respectively; and
by inserting after subparagraph (H) the following new subparagraph:

subparagraph.text: Section 1902(a)(91) (relating to parity in coverage of speech therapy services).
